name: Cisco Firepower — Malicious File Transferred (v2)
xql_query:
dataset = cisco_firepower_raw
| filter cefName = "FireAMP Event"
| alter u_tail = arrayindex(regextract(suser, "([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)$"), 0)
| alter bare_user = arrayindex(regextract(u_tail, "^([^@]+)"), 0)
| alter disposition = cs3, virus_name = cs2, event_desc = cs5
| fields src, spt, dst, dpt, app, bare_user, shost, request, dhost, fname, fileHash, fileType, sproc, cefDeviceEventClassId, cefSeverity, act, reason, virus_name, disposition, requestClientApplication
description: AMP for Networks blocked a malicious file download. Replaces rule 75, which filtered cefName = "Malicious File Detected"; FTD emits "FireAMP Event". fileHash is a 64-char SHA256, so it is mapped to the sha256 fields only. cs3/cs4 are disposition fields on FireAMP rows, not interfaces, so they are no longer mapped as interfaces.
